CAUSAL_TIMESTAMP_REQUIREMENT: Each read must have authentic effective and availability timestamp <= proposed entry; completed bars use close timestamps; revisions cannot be backdated. Missing proof yields UNKNOWN.
COMPUTE_BURDEN: Finite algebraic measurability and read-set audit; synthetic constructive witnesses only where exact maps permit them. No Monte Carlo, empirical response, power trial or bar-duration search. Exact operation bound depends on formulas and is not guessed.
EXACT_DATA_MODALITY_REQUIRED: Prospective design-semantic certificate packet: one shared explicit own-information baseline and at most eleven candidate-specific certificates. This is not a market-data capture.
EXACT_MISSING_STRUCTURAL_QUANTITY: For each of the eleven possible contenders: is sigma(Phi_i) contained in sigma(B_t) on the causally available structural domain? If not, identify a legal nonredundancy witness and the additional observable read set. This is structural measurability, not empirical conditional dependence or predictive strength.

MINIMUM_DATA_VOLUME_OR_TIME_WINDOW_IF_ST.reason: One certificate per independently distinct contender is necessary in the worst case to avoid silently discarding a competitor. Stop early if a subsequent audited functional has robust dominance; do not assume all eleven must require new data.

STOP_RULE: Do not execute this plan in the current task.

In a separately authorized semantic audit, stop a candidate as UNKNOWN if no exact formula faithful to the frozen prose or authoritative availability proof can be given. No mechanism edits to improve comparative position.
Certificate showing deterministic redundancy blocks only that exact proposal. Certificate showing nonredundancy does not certify predictive or economic information.

Reapply the frozen functional only with independently audited structural certificates. If no robust unique admissible choice exists, stop unresolved and identify the next necessary structural cut; do not acquire deeper history.
SYNCHRONIZATION_REQUIREMENT: State a required identity-time readset from the exact feature map; prove availability from schemas or accepted metadata. Do not compute real masks in this plan stage.
WHETHER_EXISTING_ACCEPTED_DATA_CAN_ANSWE: Existing frozen proposals and schema can anchor a design-semantics audit. Accepted market rows are neither needed nor sufficient to define missing exact maps. Metadata-only linkage/availability evidence may be required for relational, session, quote, term and financing candidates; if absent, stop that certificate unresolved without broker or raw data.
WHY_ANY_LARGER_ACQUISITION_WOULD_BE_PREM: More observed bars cannot resolve an unspecified baseline/estimand. Time/resource efficiency, execution realism and valid inference cannot be inferred from row counts alone. Deep duration remains downstream of one frozen complete information design.
WHY_IT_IS_OUTCOME_BLIND: Compare mathematical information maps and authentic availability semantics only. Use synthetic domain witnesses, never observed return, price response, PNL, historical classifications or successful identities. A witness proves possible nonredundancy, not profitability.
